text: A nude female figure with long, flowing red hair and amber eyes kneels on a glowing circular sigil. Her skin is smooth, peach-toned, and glistening. She has an hourglass build, prominent curves, and a slender neck. One hand rests on the sigil; the other touches her lips. Her face is oval with defined cheekbones. She wears only a thin blue bracelet on each wrist. The setting appears dark and mystical, with stone furniture and dim lighting.
